_note: Hand-written reference outputs for harness self-tests. NOT model outputs; never report them as an evaluation of a model.

01-checkout-keyerror.title: Checkout order placement fails with KeyError 'total' in place_order
01-checkout-keyerror.summary: Checkout order placement fails with KeyError 'total' (HTTP 500).
01-checkout-keyerror.root_cause: place_order reads cart['total'] but the cart object has no 'total' entry, so Cart.__getitem__ raises KeyError.

evidence.detail: KeyError 'total' raised from Cart.__getitem__ via place_order (2 occurrences).
Each failure is logged as 'order placement failed'.

repro_steps: POST /api/orders with a cart that has items

02-checkout-keyerror-repeat.title: Checkout order placement fails with KeyError 'total' in place_order
02-checkout-keyerror-repeat.summary: Same checkout KeyError a week later: exact duplicate of 01.
02-checkout-keyerror-repeat.root_cause: cart['total'] is missing when place_order computes the total.

03-order-npe.title: Order lookup throws NullPointerException in OrderService.enrich
03-order-npe.summary: Order lookup throws NullPointerException in OrderService.enrich (HTTP 500).
03-order-npe.root_cause: OrderService.enrich dereferences a null order (getCustomer on null) when the order is not loaded.

evidence.detail: NullPointerException in OrderService.enrich from OrderService.load (2 requests).

04-order-npe-variant.title: Order lookup throws NullPointerException in OrderService.enrich
04-order-npe-variant.summary: Same NPE in OrderService.enrich with a different JVM message: near duplicate of 03.
04-order-npe-variant.root_cause: OrderRepository.find returns null and OrderService.enrich calls getCustomer on it.

evidence.detail: NPE: return value of OrderRepository.find is null in OrderService.enrich.

05-cart-render-typeerror.title: Cart page render fails: cannot read 'quantity' of undefined in CartLine
05-cart-render-typeerror.summary: Cart line render TypeError; UI falls back to an empty cart.
05-cart-render-typeerror.root_cause: CartLine receives an undefined line item and reads its quantity.

evidence.detail: TypeError in CartLine during renderCart; UI falls back to an empty cart.

repro_steps: Open /cart for a session whose cart has a missing line item

06-ledger-deadlock.title: Settlement transfers rolled back by PostgreSQL deadlocks on ledger_entries
06-ledger-deadlock.summary: Settlement transfers rolled back by PostgreSQL deadlocks.
06-ledger-deadlock.root_cause: Concurrent settlement updates on ledger_entries lock rows in different orders and deadlock.

evidence.detail: Settlement batch aborted; transfers rolled back and retried.

07-payment-go-panic.title: Payment service crash loop: nil pointer dereference in gateway Client.Charge
07-payment-go-panic.summary: Payment service nil-pointer panic in a crash loop; charges not processed.
07-payment-go-panic.root_cause: charges.Process calls Charge on a nil gateway client.

evidence.detail: Go panic (nil pointer dereference) in gateway.(*Client).Charge; service in CrashLoopBackOff.

repro_steps: Process any charge after payment-svc start

08-api-gateway-502.title: Search requests fail with 502: upstream search cluster timing out
08-api-gateway-502.summary: Search returns 502: upstream search cluster timing out.
08-api-gateway-502.root_cause: The upstream search service times out, so the gateway returns 502 for POST /api/search.

09-auth-expired-token-accepted.title: Expired tokens accepted on admin routes (verify_exp disabled)
09-auth-expired-token-accepted.summary: Expired tokens accepted on admin routes (verify_exp disabled).
09-auth-expired-token-accepted.root_cause: Token expiry verification is disabled in configuration, so expired tokens authorize admin routes.

10-search-slow-queries.title: Search queries time out after 5000ms on products_v3
10-search-slow-queries.summary: Slow search queries and timeouts on products_v3.
10-search-slow-queries.root_cause: Queries on index products_v3 are slow and exceed the 5000ms timeout.

evidence.detail: Two query timeouts after 5000ms; slow-query warnings precede them.

12-mailer-missing-config.title: Order confirmation emails dropped: SMTP_HOST setting missing
12-mailer-missing-config.summary: Missing SMTP_HOST disables order confirmation emails.
12-mailer-missing-config.root_cause: SMTP_HOST is not configured, so the notification worker disables email.

evidence.detail: Missing required setting SMTP_HOST disables email.

13-empty.title: Empty log bundle: no errors to analyze
13-empty.summary: Empty log bundle (edge case: no signatures).

14-pricing-typeerror-jsonl.title: Pricing quote fails: cannot read 'quantity' of undefined in applyDiscount
14-pricing-typeerror-jsonl.summary: JSON-lines pricing TypeError; same message as 05 but different code path.
14-pricing-typeerror-jsonl.root_cause: applyDiscount reads quantity from an undefined item.

evidence.detail: TypeError in applyDiscount via quote (2 occurrences).
